findings.highlight: performances are reserved exclusively for the students of Houjou University
findings.evidenceJa: 峰城大生限定の音楽イベント
findings.explanation: The event itself is limited to students of 峰城 University. The translation instead restricts the performances to student performers, changing who may attend or participate.
findings.japanese:
大学内でミニＦＭ局を運営する放送研究サークル
『峰城ブロードキャスト』が企画、運営する
峰城大生限定の音楽イベント。
findings.todokanai: A musical event whose performances are reserved exclusively for the students of Houjou University in accord with a project known as Houjou Broadcast, hosted by a group comprising the mini FM station's broadcasting and research club.

findings.highlight: tried to reassure her
findings.evidenceJa: どれだけ口説いたか
findings.explanation: Haruki counts how insistently he wooed or courted Setsuna alongside repeating that he loved her. The translation recasts that romantic pursuit as reassurance.
findings.japanese:
どれだけ口説いたか。
どれだけ『好き』を繰り返したことか…
findings.todokanai: All those times I tried to reassure her. And all those times I told her I love her…

findings.highlight: "Go for it, Haruki. …And let me know whether your winter has ended, okay?"
findings.evidenceJa:
「頑張ってね、春希。
…あんたの冬が終わったのかどうか、
ちゃんと聴かせてもらうからね？」
findings.explanation: Chikashi literally says she will listen to the performance to determine whether Haruki's winter has ended, while the English asks him to let her know.
findings.japanese:
「頑張ってね、春希。
…あんたの冬が終わったのかどうか、
ちゃんと聴かせてもらうからね？」
findings.todokanai: "Go for it, Haruki. …And let me know whether your winter has ended, okay?"

findings.highlight: what has she been doing since the beginning of the April semester
findings.evidenceJa: 四月からの学年
findings.explanation: The source wonders what school year she will be in from April. The translation instead asks what she has been doing since April, reversing the temporal direction and replacing grade level with activity.
findings.japanese: あと、あいつの四月からの学年とか。
findings.todokanai: And just what has she been doing since the beginning of the April semester?

findings.highlight: The chances of being spotted by another girl are really low too.
findings.evidenceJa: 他の彼女に見つかるリスクは伴うけど
findings.explanation: Takeya says the cheap, atmospheric venue carries a risk of being spotted by another girlfriend. The translation says that risk is very low and makes it another advantage, reversing the joke's warning.
findings.japanese:
「安く上がる割にはムードいいからな。
他の彼女に見つかるリスクは伴うけど」
findings.todokanai: "It's cheap, and the atmosphere here is great. The chances of being spotted by another girl are really low too."

findings.highlight: the sole member who we could rely on for the music
findings.evidenceJa: 音楽的に中心にいたメンバー
findings.explanation: Kazusa was the member at the musical center of the earlier group. Calling her the sole musically reliable member converts centrality into exclusive competence and disparages the remaining performers.
findings.japanese:
しかもあの時、音楽的に中心にいたメンバーは、
今はこの場にいないと来たら…
findings.todokanai: And the worst part might be the fact that the sole member who we could rely on for the music isn't with us this time…

findings.highlight: I won't let us ever be apart.
findings.evidenceJa: 離れてなんかいない
findings.explanation: Haruki denies that the three are apart now. The translation replaces that present claim with a future promise under his control, changing both state and agency.
findings.japanese:
「離れてなんかいない。
ずっと、一緒だ」
findings.todokanai: "I won't let us ever be apart. We'll be together forever."

findings.highlight: Maybe Ogiso doesn't know.
findings.evidenceJa: 小木曽はわからなくないにしても
findings.explanation: The speaker says Ogiso's nervousness is understandable and asks why Yada is nervous. The translation makes the clause about Ogiso not knowing something, breaking the comparison that motivates the question.
findings.japanese:
「なに緊張してるのよ矢田？
小木曽はわからなくないにしても」
findings.todokanai: "What are you freaking out for, Yada? Maybe Ogiso doesn't know."

findings.highlight: Please leave me out of it
findings.evidenceJa: せめて俺を巡ってにしてくれよ
findings.explanation: Takeya jokes that if the women are going to have a showdown, it should at least be over him. The translation says the opposite: leave him out of it.
findings.japanese:
「お前らなぁ…
修羅場るならせめて俺を巡ってにしてくれよ」
findings.todokanai: "Listen, you two… Please leave me out of it if you're going to come to blows."

findings.highlight: if we'll ever be able to truly restore the bond
findings.evidenceJa: 完全に修復したかどうかもわからない
findings.explanation: Haruki is uncertain whether the broken bond has already been fully repaired. The translation turns that present uncertainty into doubt that repair will ever be possible.
findings.japanese: 壊れた絆が完全に修復したかどうかもわからない。
findings.todokanai: I don't know if we'll ever be able to truly restore the bond that we once destroyed.

findings.highlight: Still, the feelings and thoughts we are pouring into it right now are incomparable to those we had back then.
findings.evidenceJa:
けれど、そこに込められた想いだけは、
あの時の俺たちにだって引けは取ってないと思ってる。
findings.explanation: A claim that the performance is no less affecting than the earlier one becomes a claim that it is incomparable.
findings.japanese:
けれど、そこに込められた想いだけは、
あの時の俺たちにだって引けは取ってないと思ってる。
findings.todokanai: Still, the feelings and thoughts we are pouring into it right now are incomparable to those we had back then.

findings.highlight: our only friend
findings.evidenceJa: もう一人の親友
findings.explanation: Kazusa is the other close friend. Calling her their only friend excludes the friendship between Haruki and Setsuna and changes the trio's relationship structure.
findings.japanese:
遠い空にいる、もう一人の親友に、
俺たちは大丈夫だよって、伝えるために。
findings.todokanai: To tell our only friend on the other side of the horizon that everything is alright, just as before.

findings.highlight: The two of us have come together
findings.evidenceJa: かずさがいなくなって、俺たちは、二人になった
findings.explanation: The source says Kazusa left and the three thereby became two. The translation positively states that Haruki and Setsuna came together, replacing loss and subtraction with romantic union.
findings.japanese:
かずさがいなくなって、
俺たちは、二人になった。
findings.todokanai: The two of us have come togetherーin an era where Kazusa is no longer with us.

findings.highlight: continue moving on with our own lives
findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちは二人で生きていく
findings.explanation: Haruki says the two of them will live together or live as a pair from now on. The translation's separate 'own lives' erases the joint commitment.
findings.japanese: だけどこれからは、俺たちは二人で生きていく。
findings.todokanai: But even so, we must continue moving on with our own lives.

findings.highlight: Setsuna even more so
findings.evidenceJa: 俺にとってはたった一年。雪菜に至っては半年
findings.explanation: Haruki says his time with Kazusa was only a year and Setsuna's only half a year. The translation invents a comparison in which Setsuna received even more from Kazusa in half the time.
findings.japanese:
俺にとってはたった一年。
雪菜に至っては半年の…
findings.todokanai: I received so much from her in only a year; Setsuna even more so, and in half the time I had with her, no less…

findings.highlight: everythingーwe can no longer bear with us from here on out
findings.evidenceJa: 形に残らないものをもらった
findings.explanation: They received many intangible things from Kazusa. The translation says these are things they can no longer carry forward, reversing enduring influence into abandonment.
findings.japanese:
たくさんの、いろいろな、
形に残らないものをもらったから。
findings.todokanai: All of itーeverythingーwe can no longer bear with us from here on out, in any shape or form.

findings.highlight: "Well then… now that I've gained some strength for the first time in three years, maybe it's time I started working toward my own goal as well."
findings.evidenceJa:
「さてと…三年ぶりに力もらったことだし、
あたしもラストスパート頑張るか」
findings.explanation: The final push toward an already established goal is generalized into beginning toward the goal.
findings.japanese:
「さてと…三年ぶりに力もらったことだし、
あたしもラストスパート頑張るか」
findings.todokanai: "Well then… now that I've gained some strength for the first time in three years, maybe it's time I started working toward my own goal as well."

findings.highlight: You've really been wearing on us
findings.evidenceJa: こっちだって結構キてるのに
findings.explanation: The others say they are quite emotionally affected too, but cannot immerse themselves because of Yada. The translation instead says Yada has been wearing them down, changing their emotion and its cause.
findings.japanese:
「ほらぁ…もういい加減落ち着きなよ。
こっちだって結構キてるのに、
あんたのせいで浸れないじゃないか」
findings.todokanai: "Come on… it's about time you calmed down. You've really been wearing on us; we couldn't even enjoy the whole song because of you."

findings.highlight: after I graduate
findings.evidenceJa: 俺も進学したら
findings.explanation: Takahiro wonders whether he will understand once he advances to university. The translation moves the milestone to graduation, the opposite end of university life.
findings.japanese:
「ふぅん…
俺も進学したらわかるようになんのかな？」
findings.todokanai: "Hmmm… Will I be able to understand it too after I graduate?"

findings.highlight: After passing the guard
findings.evidenceJa: ガードをくぐった先
findings.explanation: ガード is the railway underpass they pass beneath on the way to the familiar apartment. The translation invents a security guard and corrupts the route description.
findings.japanese:
ガードをくぐった先の、
見慣れたマンションが、ある。
findings.todokanai: After passing the guard, we see a familiar apartment building.

findings.highlight: If I truly want the two of us to stay together forever from now on, I have to make some big decisions and follow through with them.
findings.evidenceJa:
これからも、ずっと二人でいるために、
決めなくちゃならないこと全てを洗い出したい。
findings.explanation: A promise to report every decision is reduced to following some major decisions.
findings.japanese:
これからも、ずっと二人でいるために、
決めなくちゃならないこと全てを洗い出したい。
findings.todokanai: If I truly want the two of us to stay together forever from now on, I have to make some big decisions and follow through with them.

findings.highlight: Rather than leaving her for a bit
findings.evidenceJa: 一度離れようとしてしまった以上
findings.explanation: Haruki asks whether merely changing his mind and sleeping beside Setsuna can warm her now that he already tried to leave. The translation turns that causal past act into an alternative he did not choose.
findings.japanese:
一度離れようとしてしまった以上、
このまま気が変わったと、一緒に眠るだけで、
雪菜はふたたび心から温まってくれるだろうか？
findings.todokanai: Rather than leaving her for a bit, would the sole act of changing my mind and sleeping together with her be able to warm Setsuna's heart up once again?

findings.highlight: she hasn't had enough of me spoiling her
findings.evidenceJa: 甘えるだけでは飽きたらず
findings.explanation: Setsuna is not satisfied with only acting dependent or affectionate and escalates her own behavior. The translation makes Haruki's spoiling of her the action she wants more of.
findings.japanese: しかも甘えるだけでは飽きたらず…
findings.todokanai: But it's like she hasn't had enough of me spoiling her…

findings.highlight: low blood pressure isn't something you should worry about
findings.evidenceJa: 『低血圧だろ』という指摘は
findings.explanation: After Setsuna mistakenly says low atmospheric pressure, Haruki deliberately refrains from correcting her to low blood pressure because of the mood. The translation invents medical reassurance and loses the pressure-word correction.
findings.japanese:
『低血圧だろ』という指摘は、
この場の空気を冷静に鑑みて敢えてスルーした。
findings.todokanai: I realized, after thinking about it for a moment, that "low blood pressure isn't something you should worry about" isn't an appropriate comment to make in this situation.

findings.highlight: she just doesn't know what to do
findings.evidenceJa: もう、色々とどうしたらいいのやら
findings.explanation: The first-person narration says Haruki does not know what to do with the enormous gap from last night. The translation assigns that uncertainty to Setsuna.
findings.japanese:
…昨夜とのギャップが凄すぎて、
もう、色々とどうしたらいいのやら。
findings.todokanai: …Because the gap between now and last night is too great, she just doesn't know what to do.

findings.highlight: something that we should have been dealing with
findings.evidenceJa: 三年間でゆっくり重ねるはずだった行為
findings.explanation: Setsuna tried in three hours to catch up on intimate acts they should have accumulated slowly over three years. 'Dealing with' recasts the intimacy as an unresolved problem.
findings.japanese:
俺たちが三年間でゆっくり重ねるはずだった行為に、
たった三時間で追いつこうとした。
findings.todokanai: She wanted to make up for something that we should have been dealing with over the course of three years in a mere three hours.

findings.highlight: "This really isn't the time for keen insights like that…"
findings.evidenceJa: 「穿った見方するなって…」
findings.explanation: Haruki tells Setsuna not to take a cynical or warped view, while the English calls her response a keen insight.
findings.japanese: 「穿った見方するなって…」
findings.todokanai: "This really isn't the time for keen insights like that…"

findings.highlight: with a single stream of tears, undoubtedly precious and pure
findings.evidenceJa: 一筋の涙で答え合わせをしてくれた
findings.explanation: Setsuna's tear lets Haruki check and confirm the emotional answer he has just reached. The translation leaves a descriptive fragment and omits the tear's confirming function.
findings.japanese:
何度流してみせても、その尊さにちっとも陰りの見えない
一筋の涙で答え合わせをしてくれた。
findings.todokanai: …And with a single stream of tears, undoubtedly precious and pure, no matter how many times she has shown them before.

findings.highlight: I had no choice but to trick… Uhh, I mean "appease" her with my guitar.
findings.evidenceJa:
仕方がないから雪菜を口説…じゃなくて、
それ用のツールを適当に弾いていた。
findings.explanation: The self-correction from wooing Setsuna to strumming a tool meant for that purpose is rewritten as tricking and appeasing her with a guitar.
findings.japanese:
仕方がないから雪菜を口説…じゃなくて、
それ用のツールを適当に弾いていた。
findings.todokanai: I had no choice but to trick… Uhh, I mean "appease" her with my guitar.

findings.highlight: she'd just give up and slouch on top of me
findings.evidenceJa: 俺を前屈みに…いたたまれなくさせた
findings.explanation: Setsuna's teasing leaves Haruki bent forward and unable to sit comfortably. The translation makes Setsuna give up and slump on him, reversing the subject and bodily consequence.
findings.japanese:
けれどまだ日が出てるせいなのか、
決してそれ以上の雰囲気には持ち込まず、
俺を前屈みに…いたたまれなくさせた。
findings.todokanai: But, perhaps because the sun was still up, she refused to do anything beyond that, so she'd just give up and slouch on top of me.

findings.highlight: notices what's in my heart
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の心にけじめをつけ
findings.explanation: Setsuna quickly settles matters within her own heart and reaches the actually correct conclusion. The translation says she notices what is in Haruki's heart instead.
findings.japanese:
雪菜はあっさり自分の心にけじめをつけ、
『本当は正しい』結論を出してしまった。
findings.todokanai: Setsuna easily notices what's in my heart and responds with an apt, proper conclusion to all this.

findings.highlight: She must have become aware
findings.evidenceJa: 悪魔の誘惑だって、自覚してた
findings.explanation: Haruki says he himself was conscious that this was devilish temptation. The translation assigns the awareness to Setsuna and weakens it into speculation.
findings.japanese: 悪魔の誘惑だって、自覚してた。
findings.todokanai: She must have become aware of the devilish temptation we're locked in.

findings.highlight: so many painful and cruel things I did
findings.evidenceJa: 辛いことや苦しいことが多くて
findings.explanation: Setsuna says there were many painful and difficult experiences at first, then separately apologizes for the awful things she said. The translation turns the suffering itself into painful and cruel acts she committed.
findings.japanese:
「色々とあったけど…
特に、最初は辛いことや苦しいことが多くて、
色々と酷いこと言っちゃってごめんなさい」
findings.todokanai: "So much has happened… Especially when it first started, there were so many painful and cruel things I did… And I also said so many awful things to you. For that, I'm sorry."

findings.highlight: a girl by the name of Ogiso Setsuna
findings.evidenceJa: 小木曽雪菜という“女性”
findings.explanation: The passage culminates by calling Setsuna a woman strong enough to master both her girl-like and womanly sides. The translation calls her a girl, erasing the explicit maturation contrast.
findings.japanese:
でも、その二人をねじ伏せる強さまで持ってる、
小木曽雪菜という“女性”
findings.todokanai: Someone who's capable of keeping the two contrasting strengths she holds in checkーa girl by the name of Ogiso Setsuna.

findings.highlight: It's my dutyーthis I know full well.
findings.evidenceJa: 義務感を持ってるって、思い込んでた
findings.explanation: Haruki recognizes that he only thought he was protecting Setsuna and had convinced himself he acted from duty. The translation presents protection and duty as current certainties, erasing the self-deception he is confessing.
findings.japanese:
俺が雪菜を庇護してるつもりだったのに。
義務感を持ってるって、思い込んでたのに。
findings.todokanai: I'm the one that should be protecting Setsuna. It's my dutyーthis I know full well.

findings.highlight: None of those things would ever occur to her
findings.evidenceJa: 最低の想像しか浮かんでこない
findings.explanation: Haruki says only the worst interpretations occur to him. The translation instead claims those ideas would never occur to Setsuna, changing both thinker and polarity.
findings.japanese:
…なんて、どれもこれも、
最低の想像しか浮かんでこないんだけど。
findings.todokanai: …What am I even thinking? None of those things would ever occur to her, even if she were to picture me in the worst way possible.

findings.highlight: the damage she's received
findings.evidenceJa: 実は結構ダメージを受けていた
findings.explanation: Haruki admits that he himself took a substantial emotional hit from Setsuna's answer. The translation assigns the damage to Setsuna.
findings.japanese: 実は結構ダメージを受けていた。
findings.todokanai: Such is the extent of the damage she's received.

findings.highlight: My astonishingly crafty self
findings.evidenceJa: 現金な奴
findings.explanation: Haruki calls Setsuna shamelessly quick to perk up once he makes his promise. The translation makes Haruki the crafty or opportunistic person instead.
findings.japanese: そんな、呆れるくらいに現金な奴…
findings.todokanai: My astonishingly crafty self right now…

findings.highlight: a foundation of my love toward Setsuna
findings.evidenceJa: 深い愛情だけが、今の俺のよりどころ
findings.explanation: Haruki says his small, narrow, deep love for Setsuna is the only support or anchor he has now. The translation makes an unidentified thing a foundation of that love and loses the clause's central relationship.
findings.japanese:
雪菜に対しての、小さくて、狭くて、
そして、深い愛情だけが、今の俺のよりどころ。
findings.todokanai: Is simply a foundation of my love toward Setsuna, however small and narrow, albeit deep and profound it may be.

findings.highlight: "That's fine. Even if it hurts so much that I feel I could die, I would have no complaints. …In a way, that's how I'd ideally want to die, after all."
findings.evidenceJa:
「大丈夫。
苦しくて死にそうになっても絶対に言わないよ。
だってそれ、ある意味理想の死に方だよね」
findings.explanation: Setsuna's claim that she would not tell him even if it became unbearable becomes a claim that she would have no complaints.
findings.japanese:
「大丈夫。
苦しくて死にそうになっても絶対に言わないよ。
だってそれ、ある意味理想の死に方だよね」
findings.todokanai: "That's fine. Even if it hurts so much that I feel I could die, I would have no complaints. …In a way, that's how I'd ideally want to die, after all."
